name: InboxKit
description: Sending infrastructure: connect a domain you already own, provision mailboxes, run warmup, read deliverability health. Served by ChampMail's admin API — tool_id is deliberately 'champmail' so these dispatch through the existing ChampMailDriver rather than needing a second driver and a second credential.

actions.label: InboxKit Status
actions.description: Whether the InboxKit integration is configured, and the live workspace state. Use this as a guard before any provisioning step — an unconfigured key fails every action below with a 400.

actions.label: Register Provisioning Webhook
actions.description: Point InboxKit at ChampMail's webhook ingress. Run this BEFORE buying anything: provisioning progress arrives only as domain.status_changed / mailbox.status_changed events, so registering afterwards means missing the whole lifecycle and reconciling by polling. The URL must be publicly reachable.

actions.label: Connect Existing Domain
actions.description: Attach a domain you already own. Supply cloudflare_api_token for MANAGED mode (InboxKit writes MX/SPF/DKIM itself); omit it for MANUAL mode, which returns the records for you to create in any DNS provider. The token is forwarded and never stored by ChampMail — scope it to Zone → DNS → Edit on the single zone, with an expiry, and revoke it once the domain reaches active.

domain.description: A disposable sending domain, NOT your primary business domain

cloudflare_api_token.description: MANAGED mode only. Never logged or persisted.

actions.label: Get Required DNS Records
actions.description: The MX/SPF/DKIM/verification records this domain needs before mailboxes can be provisioned. MANUAL mode only.

actions.label: Verify Domain DNS
actions.description: Re-check DNS after creating records manually. Safe to poll — a read plus a validation pass, not a mutation. Propagation is usually minutes but is governed by the TTL of any pre-existing record.

actions.label: List Connected Domains
actions.description: Domains currently attached to the workspace, with their native status.

actions.label: Buy Mailboxes
actions.description: Provision mailboxes on a connected domain. Three per domain is the safe ratio and the minimum that proves rotation actually rotates. Warmup is opt-in because it bills $3/mailbox/month and buys nothing while you are only mailing inboxes you own.

usernames.description: Local parts only — the domain is appended by InboxKit

start_warmup.description: $3/mailbox/month. Enable once you start mailing strangers.
